get_property_from_atoms: retrieve a property from an ASE Atoms object by name from its properties or info dictionary
normalize_property: normalize a property value by dividing by the number of atoms or another property value
get_property_dict_from_atoms: extract multiple properties from an ASE Atoms object into a dictionary with optional normalization
test_get_property_from_atoms: test the get_property_from_atoms function to ensure it retrieves properties from ASE Atoms objects correctly
refactor_normalize_property: refactor the normalize_property function to support additional normalization methods beyond natoms and property division
